# Code of conduct

Edison's code of conduct is [EEP 5](../eeps/eep-0005.md), which the council
accepted on 18-Sep-2026. This file exists so that it can be found from the
repository root, where a reader and the host both look for it.

## What the code is

EEP 5 does not write a code of conduct. It adopts one, whole and at one exact
revision, the way EEP 1 adopts a process: Google's, at revision
`a4219cca1f010106e7d2734340ed6f64472f2811` of `docs/code-of-conduct.md` in
`github.com/google/new-project`.

That is the text that binds. It is not copied here, because a copy drifts from
its original in silence and a pin does not. Read it at the revision above.

EEP 5 holds the substitutions needed to read it as Edison's, and the decisions
adoption forced. Read both.

## Reporting

Reports go to the council, which EEP 4 defines and which is today the owner
alone, at `soilmassive@gmail.com`.

An agent may receive a report. An agent may never decide what is done about one.
A report usually carries a third person's account of being harmed and their
identity, and that person did not agree to it reaching a model provider.

## What this code does not provide

The adopted text offers a reporter a second address to use if they are
uncomfortable approaching the steward. Edison has none. The council is one
person, so it is also the only place a report can go, and if the complaint
concerns that person there is nowhere else to take it.

This is recorded rather than glossed. It is an open issue in EEP 5 and the
strongest reason the series has to want a second person.
